about: A giants' delf cut square out of one grey stone: plain split-face walls (no library coursing, no pilasters, no niches, no wainscot), a cut floor, flat-headed giant doorways with a split-stone lintel block, a flat rock slab over the cut (the dungeon's own builder lays whole trunks under it on ledges). Giant scale: walls 1.2 m, doors 9 x 10.5.
